verdict.rationale: Jan supports connecting to cloud model providers (OpenAI, Anthropic, Mistral, Groq, etc.) as an alternative to local downloads, which lets power-users avoid downloading large models by using hosted APIs instead. However, there is no evidence of a dedicated 'hosted cloud tier' by Jan itself for offloading — it's just bring-your-own-key integration with third-party providers, not a first-party managed offload service.
